mainEntity.name: What is a tiny home rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny home rental unit is a compact, self-contained living space typically under 400 square feet, designed for residential rental purposes. These units often feature full amenities like kitchens, bathrooms, and sleeping areas within a smaller footprint. They can be a standalone structure on a property, an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), or part of a larger tiny home community. Their appeal lies in their efficiency, lower maintenance, and potential for generating rental income.
